title: Culturally-Adapted Red-Teaming Across East and Southeast Asian Contexts: A Methodological and Comparative Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Cultural Realism scores by testing language models on directly translated (DT) English red-teaming benchmarks versus culturally-adapted (CA) prompts grounded in Korean, Japanese, Thai, and Khmer cultural contexts.

Evaluating model vulnerability to 'Unfair Representation' (specifically 'Discrimination' and 'Bias and Hate' categories in the risk taxonomy) by using locally-grounded prompts that reflect country-specific societal conflicts, inter-group tensions, and ethnic or political threats.
